subject: prd/implement-now
statement: One real pyxis feature's approved e2e plan runs through `/implement-now`: every task resolves to its scenario or the harness slot from the plan's recorded e2e reference, every automatable scenario reaches a genuinely-green proposal that fails when its subject is deliberately broken and returns the same verdict on repeat runs across differently-loaded machines, every `manual-human` scenario is handed to its named owner with zero worker spawns, and no proposal changes the behavior under test.
fit_criterion: the e2e-plan run record, per-task basis resolution from EVT-12, proposal links, one broken-subject falsification result per automatable scenario, a repeat-run verdict-stability record per authored test, and a diff inspection showing no change to behavior under test
